title: Teaching Material Question Bank
description: Per EO-S1.1-001 v1.1, EO-S1.1-002 v1.0, EO-S1.1-002A v1.0, refined again by EO-S1.1-003 v1.0 (Teaching Material Package Standard). questionNumber/page are now flat fields (replacing the earlier nested 'source' object — materialId/page were the only two fields it carried, both now flat, avoiding duplication). needsManualReview is renamed needsReview to match this EO's exact field name. questionSource/origin/ocrConfidence/needsReview pairing and thresholds are enforced by scripts/ValidateMaterial.js (plain JSON Schema draft-07 can't express them without more machinery than this hand-rolled validator carries). At minimum single_choice/true_false/fill_blank; calculation/essay added only when the source material genuinely supports them.

questionNumber.description: The question's real number/label in the source material (e.g. "1", "3-b") — never renumbered by Claude

questionSource.description: ORIGINAL: copied verbatim from an exam/mock exam/past paper/teacher paper/homework/textbook exercise. AI_GENERATED: Claude-derived from the material's real content. TEACHER_CREATED: authored by a teacher, provided as such by Project Owner. materialType=EXAM (metadata.json) requires every question to be ORIGINAL.

origin.description: Must pair with questionSource: ORIGINAL -> 'Uploaded Material', AI_GENERATED -> 'AI', TEACHER_CREATED -> 'Teacher' (this third pairing is Claude's own judgment call — EO-S1.1-003 names TEACHER_CREATED as a questionSource value but doesn't state its paired origin value; flagged in README.md).

ocrConfidence.description: ORIGINAL only, required (absent for AI_GENERATED/TEACHER_CREATED). EO-S1.1-003 OCR Rule: if < 0.90, needsReview must be true; Claude must never guess/self-complete uncertain text, and a package with any such question stays manifest.json status=pending_review, not complete.

needsReview.description: ORIGINAL only, required explicit true/false (absent for AI_GENERATED/TEACHER_CREATED). True whenever ocrConfidence < 0.90, or whenever Claude is otherwise not fully certain the transcription is verbatim.

page.description: Real page number in the source material; null only when the material genuinely has none (e.g. a single-page handout)

section.description: Optional continuity field carried from EO-S1.1-001's original source-trace object — not in EO-S1.1-003's own field list, kept for extra traceability, never required

version.description: Starts "1"; incremented if this specific question is later corrected/re-transcribed

knowledgePoint.description: 選填。Sprint AI-112 AI-702: this question's own real knowledge point/concept, when the source material identifies one at question granularity (distinct from chapter-level metadata.chapter). Formalizes a field the data/materials/ track's own real material (CivicsG10Ch5to6Exam20260730.js) already carries per question — this schema previously had no equivalent, a real gap closed here, not invented.

difficulty.description: 選填，此題本身的難度（區別於 metadata.json 的教材整體 difficulty）。同上，格式化既有真實用法，未新增資料。
